scope: 10 bounded paper decision scenarios; no rendered UI/video, Opus/Jev or all172competencies benchmark
limitations: One generation per case/variant, no statistical or causal improvement estimate
Labels hidden but wording/evidence may allow inference
Knowledge and added profile vary together, so effects are not attributable to one component
